right-hamichlolads-exempt:
{{doc-right|hamichlolads-exempt}}
Users with this right see no ads unless they check {{msg-mw|hamichlolads-pref-show}} in their preferences.
prefs-hamichlolads: Section header in the Appearance tab of [[Special:Preferences]].
hamichlolads-pref-show: Checkbox label in [[Special:Preferences]], shown only to users with the hamichlolads-exempt right.
hamichlolads-policy: Tooltip and accessible name of the info icon on the ads feed, which links to {{msg-mw|hamichlolads-policypage}}.
hamichlolads-policypage:
{{notranslate}}
Name of the page that the info icon on the ads feed links to. Set to "-" to remove the icon.
